item_text: I can raise concerns about problems in this team without fear of negative consequences.
I feel safe admitting my mistakes to members of this team.
I can ask members of this team for help without worrying that they will think less of me.
I can openly disagree with others in this team without damaging my relationships with them.
I feel comfortable proposing ideas in this team even when they might not work.
I can express aspects of who I am in this team without fear of rejection.
I can ask questions in this team without worrying that I will look uninformed.
